# Canvas Escape

Control a small ship that continuously moves forward through an endless field of randomly generated obstacles. Use arrow keys to rotate and thrust, avoid collisions, and collect occasional fuel cells for score. The game ends when the ship collides with any obstacle.

<type>file</type>
<content>
1: // Simple endless‑space ship game with improved graphics
2: // Canvas id="game" – assumes full‑size canvas in HTML
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Resize to fill parent
8:   const resize = () => {
9:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
10:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
11:   };
12:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
13:   resize();
14: 
15:   // Ship state
16:   const ship = {
17:     x: canvas.width / 2,
18:     y: canvas.height / 2,
19:     angle: 0, // radians
20:     vx: 0,
21:     vy: 0,
22:     radius: 10,
23:   };
24: 
25:   const keys = { left: false, right: false, up: false };
26:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
27:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = true;
28:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = true;
29:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp') { keys.up = true; playThrust(); }
30:   });
31:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
32:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
33:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
34:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp') { keys.up = false; stopThrust(); }
35:   });
36: 
37:   const obstacles = [];
38:   const fuels = [];
39:   const stars = [];
40:   const particles = [];
41:   // sound context and helpers
42:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
43:   let thrustOsc = null;
44:   const playThrust = () => {
45:     if (thrustOsc) return;
46:     thrustOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
47:     thrustOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(150, audioCtx.currentTime);
48:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
49:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
50:     thrustOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
51:     thrustOsc.start();
52:   };
53:   const stopThrust = () => {
54:     if (thrustOsc) {
55:       thrustOsc.stop();
56:       thrustOsc.disconnect();
57:       thrustOsc = null;
58:     }
59:   };
60:   const playCollision = () => {
61:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
62:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
63:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(80, audioCtx.currentTime);
64:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
65:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
66:     osc.start();
67:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
68:   };
69:   const playFuel = () => {
70:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
71:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
72:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, audioCtx.currentTime);
73:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, audioCtx.currentTime);
74:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
75:     osc.start();
76:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
77:   };
78:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
79:   let fuelTimer = 0;
80:   let starTimer = 0;
81:   let score = 0;
82:   let gameOver = false;
83: 
84:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
85:     // obstacles with gradient fill
86:     const side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'top' : 'left';
87:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
88:     const obj = {
89:       x: side === 'top' ? Math.random() * canvas.width : -radius,
90:       y: side === 'top' ? -radius : Math.random() * canvas.height,
91:       vx: 1 + Math.random() * 1.5,
92:       vy: 1 + Math.random() * 1.5,
93:       radius,
94:       // random hue for obstacle color
95:       color: `hsl(${Math.random() * 360},70%,60%)`,
96:     };
97:     // move towards bottom‑right (ship forward direction)
98:     obj.vx *= Math.cos(ship.angle);
99:     obj.vy *= Math.sin(ship.angle);
100:     obstacles.push(obj);
101:   };
102:     const side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'top' : 'left';
103:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
104:     const obj = {
105:       x: side === 'top' ? Math.random() * canvas.width : -radius,
106:       y: side === 'top' ? -radius : Math.random() * canvas.height,
107:       vx: 1 + Math.random() * 1.5,
108:       vy: 1 + Math.random() * 1.5,
109:       radius,
110:     };
111:     // move towards bottom‑right (ship forward direction)
112:     obj.vx *= Math.cos(ship.angle);
113:     obj.vy *= Math.sin(ship.angle);
114:     obstacles.push(obj);
115:   };
116: 
117:   const spawnFuel = () => {
118:     const obj = {
119:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
120:       y: -20,
121:       vx: 0,
122:       vy: 1.5,
123:       radius: 8,
124:     };
125:     fuels.push(obj);
126:   };
127: 
128:   const spawnStar = () => {
129:     const s = {
130:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
131:       y: -2,
132:       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
133:       speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
134:       radius: 1 + Math.random() * 1,
135:     };
136:     stars.push(s);
137:   };
138: 
139:   const createParticles = (x, y, count = 8) => {
140:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
141:       particles.push({
142:         x,
143:         y,
144:         vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
145:         vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
146:         life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
147:         decay: 1,
148:         radius: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
149:         color: `hsl(${Math.random() * 360},80%,60%)`,
150:       });
151:     }
152:   };
153: 
154:   const update = dt => {
155:     if (gameOver) return;
156:     // ship controls
157:     if (keys.left) ship.angle -= 0.04;
158:     if (keys.right) ship.angle += 0.04;
159:     if (keys.up) {
160:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * 0.1;
161:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * 0.1;
162:     }
163:     // drag
164:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
165:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
166:     ship.x += ship.vx;
167:     ship.y += ship.vy;
168:     // wrap around edges
169:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += canvas.width;
170:     if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x -= canvas.width;
171:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += canvas.height;
172:     if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y -= canvas.height;
173: 
174:     // spawn obstacles/fuel/stars
175:     obstacleTimer += dt;
176:     fuelTimer += dt;
177:     starTimer += dt;
178:     if (obstacleTimer > 1500) { spawnObstacle(); obstacleTimer = 0; }
179:     if (fuelTimer > 3000) { spawnFuel(); fuelTimer = 0; }
180:     if (starTimer > 100) { spawnStar(); starTimer = 0; }
181: 
182:     // move obstacles and fuels
183:     obstacles.forEach(o => { o.x += o.vx; o.y += o.vy; });
184:     fuels.forEach(f => { f.x += f.vx; f.y += f.vy; });
185:     // move stars for background
186:     stars.forEach(s => { s.y += s.speed; s.x += s.vx; });
187:     // move particles
188:     particles.forEach(p => { p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.life -= p.decay; });
189:     // remove off‑screen and dead
190:     const off = arr => arr.filter(o => o.x < canvas.width && o.y < canvas.height && o.x > -50 && o.y > -50);
191:     obstacles.splice(0, obstacles.length, ...off(obstacles));
192:     fuels.splice(0, fuels.length, ...off(fuels));
193:     stars.splice(0, stars.length, ...stars.filter(s => s.y < canvas.height && s.x > -5 && s.x < canvas.width + 5));
194:     particles.splice(0, particles.length, ...particles.filter(p => p.life > 0));
195: 
196:     // collisions
197:     for (const o of obstacles) {
198:       const dx = o.x - ship.x, dy = o.y - ship.y;
199:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < o.radius + ship.radius) {
200:         gameOver = true;
201:         createParticles(ship.x, ship.y, 30);
202:         playCollision();
203:         break;
204:       }
205:     }
206:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
207:       const f = fuels[i];
208:       if (Math.hypot(f.x - ship.x, f.y - ship.y) < f.radius + ship.radius) {
209:         score += 10;
210:         createParticles(f.x, f.y, 12);
211:         playFuel();
212:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
213:       }
214:     }
215:     score += dt * 0.01; // survival score
216:   };
217: 
218:   const draw = () => {
219:     // background gradient (space dark)
220:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
221:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
222:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
223:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
224:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
225: 
226:     // stars (tiny points)
227:     ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
228:     stars.forEach(s => {
229:       ctx.beginPath();
230:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
231:       ctx.fill();
232:     });
233: 
234:     // ship with gradient fill
235:     ctx.save();
236:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
237:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
238:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-15, 0, 15, 0);
239:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
240:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#005');
241:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
242:     ctx.beginPath();
243:     ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
244:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -7);
245:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 7);
246:     ctx.closePath();
247:     ctx.fill();
248:     ctx.restore();
249: 
250:     // obstacles with individual colors
251:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
252:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
253:       ctx.beginPath();
254:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
255:       ctx.fill();
256:     });
257: 
258:     // fuel cells
259:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
260:     fuels.forEach(f => {
261:       ctx.beginPath();
262:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
263:       ctx.fill();
264:     });
265: 
266:     // particles (explosions, fading)
267:     particles.forEach(p => {
268:       ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(p.life / 50, 0);
269:       ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
270:       ctx.beginPath();
271:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
272:       ctx.fill();
273:     });
274:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
275: 
276:     // HUD
277:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
278:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
279:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
280:     if (gameOver) {
281:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
282:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
283:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
284:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
285:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
286:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
287:     }
288:   };
289: 
290:   let last = performance.now();
291:   const loop = now => {
292:     const dt = now - last;
293:     last = now;
294:     update(dt);
295:     draw();
296:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
297:   };
298:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
299: })();

(End of file - total 299 lines)
</content>
